messages:
oliver: Heads-up — cutoff in ~4h for v0.23. We need quick signoffs on QA, security, and docs. I will cut the release branch at +3h unless someone asks for an exception.

sara: On it. QA smoke window open now; running full smoke suite against canary. will post failures if any. :eyes:

kevin: Docs team — I pushed the user-visible changelog stub at docs/changelog/v0.23.md, needs one sentence per major change + migration note. pinging @docs-team.

docs-team: Saw it — adding migration note for token billing change and the batching behavior tweak. Will PR in ~30m.

nisha: Security review: I verified dependency updates and ran the SBOM check. One low sev transitive vuln in build tooling — doesn't affect runtime but I filed a ticket (INF-4321). No blocker for release.

security-bot: Automated security scan complete — 0 critical, 2 high (both in infra tooling). See https://sec.internal/reports/1977654321.

oliver: Thanks. Minor ask: if QA finds anything that requires a hotpatch, we should prepare a release-hotpatch branch off main and cherry-pick PRs. Keven/Nisha — who can own the hotpatch cut if needed?

kevin: I can cut the hotpatch branch and do the cherry-picks. Will coordinate with ops for deploy.

sara: QA progress: 3 flaky tests failed (timing), not release-blocking. Logging shows increased p99 latency in embedding lambda on canary — investigating perf regression.

oliver: Noted. If embedding latency holds >+25% we fallback canary to previous model variant; ops will hold traffic routing.

nisha: Confirmed rollback plan and fallback policy in place. No escalation needed yet.

kevin: Version bump procedure reminder: run `scripts/bump_version.sh 0.23.1` then `git tag v0.23.1 && git push --tags`. Also update release notes with changelog entry.

docs-team: PR opened to publish changelog + migration note: PR #987.

qa-bot: Smoke tests: 142 tests run, 139 passed, 3 flaky. Full suite ETA ~45m.

oliver: Final checklist before branch cut (+3h):
- QA green on full suite or agreed downgrade plan
- docs PR merged
- security ticket triaged (not blocker)
- version bump committed + tag ready
- release owner assigned (kevin) + on-call aware

oliver: If anyone objects to the cutoff, call it out now. Otherwise I'll proceed with the cut in 3h and post exact commands and branch name here. :rocket:
